title: Demonstration-Free Skill Composition for Navigation and Manipulation
title_zh: 面向导航与操作的无示范技能组合
abstract_en: Hierarchical reinforcement learning enables sequential tasks to be represented as compositions of separately trained skills. This paper evaluates demonstration-free hierarchical pipelines for MiniGrid navigation and robotic manipulation, comparing their training requirements and task performance with flat reinforcement learning baselines. The evaluation concerns complete pipelines with task-specific observation, reward and control structures. In navigation, two parameterised skills are reused across unseen FourRooms layouts under manually specified high-level plans. In manipulation, reaching, grasp alignment and lifting are trained separately, with downstream skills initialised from states collected during predecessor rollouts. Across unseen navigation layouts, the hierarchical pipeline substantially outperforms the evaluated flat DQN baselines while requiring fewer training interactions. In manipulation, the hierarchical chain requires fewer training steps than flat SAC and exhibits lower observed variation across seeds. The frozen Pick and Lift skills are further reused for stacking by training an additional Place skill.
abstract_zh: 分层强化学习将序列任务拆解为可独立训练、按需组合的技能。本文在 MiniGrid 导航和机器人操作任务中评估无需示范的分层训练流程，并与扁平强化学习基线比较训练开销和任务表现。导航实验在人工指定的高层计划下，将两个参数化技能复用于未见过的 FourRooms 布局。与所评估的扁平 DQN 基线相比，分层流程使用更少的训练交互，并在未见布局上取得显著更好的表现。操作实验分别训练接近目标、抓取对齐和抬升技能，并从前序技能的执行轨迹中采集状态，作为后续技能的训练起点。相比扁平 SAC，分层技能链所需的训练步数更少，且实验中不同随机种子间的表现波动更小。研究还冻结并复用 Pick 和 Lift 技能，仅额外训练 Place 技能即可完成堆叠任务。
key_points_zh: 导航：在人工指定的高层计划下，两个参数化技能可复用于未见过的 FourRooms 布局，所需训练交互更少，表现优于所评估的扁平 DQN 基线。
操作：用前序技能执行时采集的状态初始化后续技能训练；相比扁平 SAC，分层技能链训练步数更少，观察到的跨随机种子波动也更小。
技能复用：冻结已有的 Pick 和 Lift，只需新增并训练 Place 技能，即可将技能链扩展到堆叠任务。
比较范围：实验对比的是包含任务特定观测、奖励与控制设计的完整流程，不能将收益单独归因于分层结构。
